Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LI OF 2000
ELECTROL ROLLS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LI OF 2000
Art Ordinance further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act,
1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary; Part I,
27th September, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 27‑9‑2000.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Electoral Rolls (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Substitution of section 4, Act XXI of 1974

ORDINANCE LI OF 2000
ELECTROL ROLLS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LI OF 2000
Art Ordinance further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act,
1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary; Part I,
27th September, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 27‑9‑2000.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Substitution of section 4, Act XXI of 1974.‑‑In the Electoral Rolls Act, 1974
(XXI of 1974), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 4 the
following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"4. Preparation and computerisation of
electoral rolls for election to the Assemblies.‑‑(1) The
Commissioner shall cause to be prepared the electoral rolls for election to the
National Assembly and Provincial Assemblies afresh or by revising the electoral
rolls existing immediately before the commencement of Electoral Rolls
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2000, and revised from time to time in the prescribed
manner
(2) The Commissioner shall ' make arrangements
for the computerisation of the electoral rolls in the manner as he may
determine and any printout of the computer maintained by, or with the authority
of, the Commissioner shall be deemed to be an electoral roll published under
this Act:".

Amendment of section 6, Act XXI of 1974

No.F.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 27‑9‑2000.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
3. Amendment of section 6, Act XXI of 1974.‑‑In the said Act, in section 6,‑‑
(a) for subsection .(1) the following shall be
substituted, namely:‑‑
"(1) Subject to the superintendence,
directions and control of the Commissioner, the Registration Officer shall
prepare the electoral rolls by including therein the name of every person
entitled to be enrolled as voter in the electoral area under this Act.";
and
(b) in subsection (2), after clause (b), the
following new clause shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"(ba) possesses the National Identity Card
issued, or deemed to have been issued, to him under the National Database and
Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000);".

Amendment of section 18, Act XXI of 1974

ORDINANCE LI OF 2000
ELECTROL ROLLS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LI OF 2000
Art Ordinance further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act,
1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary; Part I,
27th September, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 27‑9‑2000.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
4. Amendment of section 18, Act XXI of 1974.‑‑In the said Act, in section 18,‑‑
(x) in subsection (1),‑‑
(i) tot the words, comma, figures and brackets
"issued to him under the National Registration Act; 1973 (LVI of
1973)" the words, commas, figures and brackets 'issued, or deemed to have
been issued, to him under the National Database and Registration Authority
Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000)", shall be substituted; and .
(ii) for the full stop at the end, a colon
shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added,
namely:‑‑
"Provided that 'if the name of applicant
is already included in the electoral roll of any other electoral area of the
same district or any other district, the Registration Officer shall strike off
his name from the roll of that other electoral area of the same district and
inform the Registration Officer of other district who shall, on receipt of the
information, strike off the name' of the applicant from that roll.";
(b) after subsection (2), the following new
subsection shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(3) Where the Registration Officer
rejects application made under subsection (1) or subsection (2), he shall
record in writing brief reasons of his decision.
(4) A person aggrieved by the order .of the
Registration Officer made under subsection (1) or subsection (2) may, within
thirty days of such order, appeal to the appellate authority to be appointed by
the Commissioner and the decision of such authority given thereon shall be
final.".

Addition of new sections, Act XXI of 1974

ELECTROL ROLLS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LI OF 2000
Art Ordinance further to amend the Electoral Rolls Act,
1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary; Part I,
27th September, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000‑Pub., dated 27‑9‑2000.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
6. Addition of new sections, Act XXI of 1974.‑‑In the said Act, after section 29,
the following new sections shall be added, namely:‑‑
"30. Breach of official duty.‑‑Where
a Registration Officer, an Assistant Registration Officer or any other person
appointed in connection with official duty under this Act, wilfully or without
reasonable cause, commits breach of official duty by any act or omission, the
Commissioner may suspend such officer or person and initiate proceedings
against him and refer the case alongwith statement of allegations to the
Federal Government where such officer or person is serving under the Federal
Government and in other cases the Provincial Government.
31. Certain offences triable by Registration
Officer.‑ Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), the Registration Officer, if so authorised by
the Commissioner in this behalf, may‑‑‑
(a) exercise the powers of a Magistrate of the
first class under the said Code in respect of the offences punishable under
sections 172, 173, 174, 175, 177, 178, 179, 180, 182, 186, 187, 188, 189, 191,
196, 197, 198, 199, 200, 464 and 471 of the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 (Act XLV
of 1860); and
(b) take cognizance of any such offence and
shall try it summarily in accordance with the provisions of Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), relating to summary trials.".
